feedback.issue: Two instances of 'any' type in function parameters (cfn-loop2.ts:387, cfn-product-owner.ts:327)
feedback.root_cause: @trigger.dev/sdk package exports IO interface without TypeScript type definitions - this is a limitation of the external dependency, not the implementation
feedback.impact: Minimal - all other parameters and return types are fully typed. The SDK limitation is unavoidable.
feedback.suggestion: Document the exception. When/if trigger.dev releases TypeScript definitions for the IO interface, update to import and use the proper type. This is not a code defect but rather a limitation of the external library.
feedback.verdict: ACCEPTABLE - Zero-any policy effectively met with one documented exception

feedback.issue: Shell escaping via string replacement could be more robust using array-based execSync
feedback.root_cause: String concatenation requires manual shell escaping. Array-based execution eliminates this requirement.
feedback.impact: Current implementation is functionally secure. Shell escaping (quotes, dollar signs, backticks) is correctly implemented. This is an enhancement opportunity, not a security defect.
feedback.implementation_effort: Medium - requires refactoring docker command building

feedback.issue: Consensus score parsing could be more readable
Product Owner decision parsing uses very broad fallback pattern that could match false positives
feedback.issue_detail: The third pattern would match 'ITERATE' even in error messages like 'processing will iterate'
feedback.root_cause: Fallback pattern too permissive for safety. However, code returns ABORT on parse failure, which is safe.
feedback.impact: Low - code defaults to ABORT decision on ambiguity, which is safe/conservative
feedback.priority: Low - current fallback behavior is safe

feedback.issue: Environment variable contract usage could be better documented in README
feedback.location: Both cfn-loop2.ts and cfn-product-owner.ts use getEnvValue() and getNetworkName()
feedback.priority: Low - code is functional and self-documenting
